cookieAuth.name: subsurf_access
cookieAuth.description: Access JWT set by `POST /auth/login`, refreshed through `POST /auth/refresh`.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Sets two httpOnly cookies: `subsurf_access` (15 min JWT) and `subsurf_refresh` (7 days, path `/v1/auth`). Five failed attempts in a row lock the account for 15 minutes. Every failure (unknown email, wrong password, locked or deactivated account) returns the same 401.

401.description: Invalid credentials (`INVALID_CREDENTIALS`)

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Reads the `subsurf_refresh` cookie. Presenting an already rotated refresh token revokes the whole session.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

post.summary: Sign out
post.description: Revokes the current session and clears both cookies. Always succeeds.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their role and permissions
get.description: Also works while `mustChangePassword` is true.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

post.summary: Change the signed-in user's password
post.description: Signs out every other session of this user and clears `mustChangePassword`.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Current password is wrong (`INVALID_CREDENTIALS`)

get.description: Requires `scans:read`. The newest scan with results compared with the previous one: host counts, the lifecycle of every known host, and the changes that deserve a look first.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

get.summary: DefectDojo connection and the last sync
get.description: Requires `defectdojo:read`.

200.description: Whether DefectDojo is configured, and the last sync

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

post.summary: Pull the current DefectDojo data into hosts and services
post.description: Requires `defectdojo:import`. Reads every product and finding, matches findings to services by host:port and imports: finding tags (service tags), product tags and owners (host tags, `owner:`/`contact:`), triage of services that are still `unreviewed`, and remediation dates. Tags are merged into the user tags; nothing users set is overwritten.

200.description: The finished sync with what it changed

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

502.description: DefectDojo did not answer or refused the token (`DEFECTDOJO_UNAVAILABLE`)

post.summary: Push a scan's services to DefectDojo as informational findings
post.description: Requires `defectdojo:export`. One `Info` finding per service (Generic Findings Import) in the product `SubSurf discovery`: the first push is an import, later ones reimport into the same test. A whole-scan push closes findings of services the scan no longer sees (unknown hosts keep theirs); a push of `hostIds`/`serviceIds` closes nothing. Triage maps to `false_p` and `verified`; service tags become finding tags.

200.description: The finished push with DefectDojo's counts

400.description: Validation failed, or nothing to push (`NOTHING_TO_PUSH`)

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

502.description: DefectDojo did not answer or rejected the report (`DEFECTDOJO_UNAVAILABLE`)

get.description: Requires `scans:read`. Newest first, with host counts and open ports so far.

get.summary: Get a scan with its jobs and the changes since the base scan
get.description: Requires `scans:read`. Changes are counted against the base scan: `base` if given (it must be older), otherwise the previous scan with results. `coverage` counts the addresses each scan answered for; a host is only `new` or `gone` where both did.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

patch.summary: Change a scan's name and note
patch.description: Requires `scans:read` and `scans:update`. Works in any state of the scan. Only the name and the note change: what the scan found and the parameters it ran with are never edited. The note is encrypted at rest.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

delete.summary: Delete a scan with everything it observed
delete.description: Requires `scans:read` and `scans:delete`. Removes the scan, its jobs and its observations. Hosts and services stay, with their notes, tags and triage, and the other scans are then compared with each other. A running scan answers `409 SCAN_RUNNING`.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

get.summary: List the hosts of a scan, with their services and changes
get.description: Requires `scans:read`. Hosts that were up in this scan, plus hosts that were up in the base scan (`base`, or the previous scan with results) and are now `down` (gone) or did not answer (unknown), in address order. Each service carries the base scan's observation (`before`).

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

get.summary: Get a host as one scan saw it
get.description: Requires `scans:read`. Services with their decrypted details from this scan, compared with the base scan (`base`, or the previous scan with results), and the address's scan history.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

post.summary: Add a tag to, or remove it from, the scan's hosts in the given addresses and CIDRs
post.description: Requires `scans:read` and `hosts:update`. Matches the hosts the scan lists (gone and unknown included). Tags belong to the Host assets, so the change shows in every scan and later scans keep it. Hosts that already have the maximum number of tags are skipped.

200.description: How many hosts matched and how many changed

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

get.summary: Export the changes since the base scan, one row per change, as JSON or CSV
get.description: Requires `scans:read`. Compared with `base` (older) or the previous scan with results. Rows for new, gone and unknown hosts, opened and closed ports, and each changed field, with a priority and its reason. CSV cells that start with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` get a leading `'` so spreadsheets do not run them as formulas.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

get.summary: Export a scan's results, with the users' edits, as JSON or CSV
get.description: Requires `scans:read`. Every address the scan covered as this scan saw it, sensitive fields decrypted, plus the notes, tags, triage and service corrections of its hosts. JSON lists the addresses that are not `down` in the worker result's host shape and names the covered blocks in `coverage` (an address in them without an entry is `down`); `POST /scans/import` reads the file back. CSV has one row per HTTP endpoint and leaves out headers, cookies, certificates, banners and probes; cells that start with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` get a leading `'`.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

post.summary: Import a results file as a new scan
post.description: Requires `scans:read` and `scans:create`; `edits=fill` also requires `hosts:update`. The body is the file itself: a scan export (`GET /scans/{id}/export`) as JSON or CSV, one worker result (`{ scan, hosts }`, docs/worker-result-format.md) or a list of them. CSV needs only an `ip` column; rows it cannot read are skipped and reported in `warnings`. The results are ingested the way a worker's own are. The scan takes its place among the others by when the file says it ran, so it can become the base scan of a newer one. The same content is imported once (`SCAN_ALREADY_IMPORTED` carries the existing scan's id in `details.scanId`). `SCAN_IMPORT_INVALID` lists what is wrong in `details.issues`.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

409.description: The file was imported before, or another import is running

get.summary: List a scan's jobs
get.description: Requires `scans:read`. In step order, then sequence; `step` and `status` filter. A step that takes the previous step's hosts gets a job each time one of the previous step's jobs completes.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

post.summary: Stop a scan
post.description: Requires `scans:read` and `scans:run`. Queued jobs are stopped; leased ones finish their current run (worker-manager has no cancel channel), and the scan ends once they do.

204.description: Stopped, or stopping once the leased jobs end

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

post.summary: Import IP addresses, CIDR ranges, IP ranges and domains
post.description: Requires `targets:create`; with `startScan: true` also `scans:run`. Adds the entries to the target inventory; values already there are counted as `skipped` and keep their note and tags (`tags` only go to the targets this import creates). With `startScan`, queues a scan of every entry: domains are resolved to IPv4 addresses and the addresses are split into scan jobs. Accepts IPv4, CIDRs up to /16, IPv4 ranges (`10.0.0.1-10.0.0.200`, stored as the CIDR blocks that cover them) and domains; the body may be up to 10 MB.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

get.description: Requires `vulnerabilities:read`. Each source (NVD, OSV) is mirrored into the database by the `vuln-sync` process: incrementally every few hours, fully once a week and on request.

post.description: Requires `vulnerabilities:run`. Queues the request; the `vuln-sync` process picks it up within its poll interval and re-matches every service afterwards. A request already waiting for the same source is returned instead of a new one.

200.description: Mappings, sorted by vendor and product

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

post.description: Requires `vulnerabilities:create`. Queues a re-match of every service.

patch.description: Requires `vulnerabilities:update`. The verdict belongs to users: it is kept per service and vulnerability, so it survives syncs, retractions and later scans. The note is encrypted at rest.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

get.summary: List the workers pipelines are built from, and the worker managers seen
get.description: Requires `workers:read`. Built-in workers come from the code catalog; a name a manager offers that the catalog lacks is registered as a disabled custom worker.

200.description: Workers by stage, then managers by last seen

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

patch.summary: Enable or disable a worker, or change its rate cap and defaults
patch.description: Requires `workers:update`. A built-in worker accepts only `enabled`, `maxRate` and `defaults`; a custom one also its description, stage, inputs, split strategies and fields. `defaults` must match the worker's fields.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

409.description: A built-in worker's definition cannot change (`WORKER_BUILTIN`)

delete.summary: Delete a custom worker no pipeline uses

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: Missing permission, or the user must change their password first

409.description: Built-in (`WORKER_BUILTIN`) or used by a pipeline (`WORKER_IN_USE`)

post.summary: Lease queued scan jobs to a worker-manager (long poll)
post.description: Called by worker-manager in `--poll` mode with `Authorization: Bearer <WORKER_TOKEN>`. Records the manager and the workers it offers (unknown names become disabled custom workers), then leases up to `max_parallel` × `WORKER_LEASE_JOBS_PER_SLOT` queued jobs of running scans whose worker is enabled and offered. Without work it holds the request for up to `wait_seconds` (at most 60) and answers 204. Each job's `deadline` is capped by the scan's time window; its lease lasts until the deadline plus `WORKER_LEASE_GRACE_SECONDS`.

200.description: Leased jobs, in worker-manager's job list format

401.description: Missing or wrong worker token

503.description: Worker endpoints are disabled: the backend has no WORKER_TOKEN

post.summary: Upload one worker run's result
post.description: Called by worker-manager with `Authorization: Bearer <WORKER_TOKEN>` after each task. `result` is the locked format of docs/worker-result-format.md. A leased job split into tasks comes back as one upload per task, all with the job's `jobId` and `leaseId`; `task_index` tells them apart. Resending the same lease and task is a no-op. Every address must be inside the job's targets and every open port inside the scan's ports. The body may be up to 64 MB and gzip-compressed (`Content-Encoding: gzip`).

200.description: Result stored, or already stored for this lease and task

401.description: Missing or wrong worker token

503.description: Worker endpoints are disabled: the backend has no WORKER_TOKEN

post.description: The locked result format in docs/worker-result-format.md.
